batch_node.name: Genericom EC2 arrangements v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Post-layout arrangement rules used by the EC2 internal projection: ALB ingress row, internal app row, lo-iface follow-port.

node.name: arr-genericom-ec2-alb-ingress-row
node.description: Aligns the ALB and its tcp_connection on the same horizontal row as the EC2's eth0 :80 port — the public-ingress chain.

anchor.gryphon: MATCH (ec2:aws_ec2_instance)-[:HOSTS]->(iface:network_interface)<-[:ATTACHED_TO]-(p:port) WHERE ec2.entity_id = $entity_id AND p.port_number = 80 RETURN p

members.gryphon: MATCH (ec2:aws_ec2_instance)-[:HOSTS]->(iface:network_interface)<-[:ATTACHED_TO]-(p:port)<-[:CONNECTS_TO]-(tcp:tcp_connection)<-[:CONNECTS_TO]-(alb:aws_alb) WHERE ec2.entity_id = $entity_id AND p.port_number = 80 RETURN tcp, alb

node.name: arr-genericom-ec2-internal-app-row
node.description: Aligns gunicorn and Django on the same horizontal row as the lo :8000 port — the internal proxy chain inside the EC2.

anchor.gryphon: MATCH (ec2:aws_ec2_instance)-[:HOSTS]->(iface:network_interface)<-[:ATTACHED_TO]-(p:port) WHERE ec2.entity_id = $entity_id AND p.port_number = 8000 RETURN p

node.name: arr-genericom-ec2-lo-iface-follows-port
node.description: Pulls the lo network_interface onto the same horizontal row as the lo :8000 port so the loopback iface tracks its port.

anchor.gryphon: MATCH (ec2:aws_ec2_instance)-[:HOSTS]->(iface:network_interface)<-[:ATTACHED_TO]-(p:port) WHERE ec2.entity_id = $entity_id AND p.port_number = 8000 RETURN p

members.gryphon: MATCH (ec2:aws_ec2_instance)-[:HOSTS]->(iface:network_interface)<-[:ATTACHED_TO]-(p:port) WHERE ec2.entity_id = $entity_id AND p.port_number = 8000 RETURN iface
